name: Chiming Rap
description: Rap the foe with a chime in each knuckle so that the sound is felt as two small blows.

name: Pairing Cover
description: Ring two small bells of air beside the shoulders that between them turn a blow.

name: Peal Step
description: Step from one peal to the next so quickly that the foe hears only one.

name: Matched Peals
description: Ring two matched peals one after the other so that the second breaks the guard the first has loosened.

name: Chime Sensing
description: Ring a small chime and read from its fading where each living body in the room stands.

name: Bell Rebound
description: Ring a bell against a blow to bounce it aside and answer on the rebound.

name: Bellfounder's Blow
description: Strike with the whole body cast like a bell so that the blow rings through the foe to the ground.

name: Bell Mantle
description: Hang a mantle of ringing bells about the user that shakes the force out of blows.

name: Doubled Toll
description: Toll two great bells together in the chest so that one stroke lands with the weight of both.

name: Twin Carillon
description: Ring a school carillon of two bells in unison and loose their joined peal as one stroke that staggers all foes near the user.

name: Chord Rap
description: Rap three fingers on the foe at once so that three notes ring as a small chord.

name: Steady Chord
description: Hold a steady chord about the user that adds its voices to the guard.

name: Cadence Step
description: Resolve a tense moment with one step that lands exactly where the chord says it should.

name: Tonic Strike
description: Strike on the home note of the chord so that the blow settles with full weight.

name: Fifth Guard
description: Raise a guard built on the fifth above the tonic that is firm and wide and hard to break.

name: Chord Reading
description: Strike a chord and listen to which voices come back to learn who stands near and how they are armed.

name: Dissonant Chord
description: Sound a jarring chord at the foe's ear that breaks their rhythm and their focus.

name: Full Chord
description: Strike every note of the chord at once to shake all foes within reach.

name: Suspended Chord
description: Hold a chord unresolved over one foe so that tension weighs on them until they are forced to still.

name: Resolved Chord
description: Resolve the suspended chord in a single crashing stroke whose release strikes the foe like a falling hall.

name: Sovereign Chord
description: Sound the court's closing chord so that the blow lands with the authority of the court and the foe is held still under its judgement.

name: Hawk Rap
description: Rap with a quick hawk cry so that the foe flinches before the blow lands.

name: Pinion Hum
description: Spread pinions of thin sound at the arms that sweep aside low strikes.

name: Rising Pace
description: Rise on a climbing note and cross the gap to the foe in a single swing.

name: Highest Note
description: Raise a note to the very top of hearing and drive it through the foe's guard as a thin pin.

name: Raptor Hearing
description: Hear as a raptor hears the lightest step of a hidden thing in the field below.

name: Hunting Shout
description: Shout the hunter's call that freezes the foe's reaction and strike as they stiffen.

name: Skyward Cry
description: Cry upward and let the cry fall on a distant foe as a plunging spear of sound.

name: Plunging Cry
description: Plunge with a cry at full pitch and strike the foe with the whole falling weight.

name: Talon Shriek
description: Gather the shriek into a talon of sound and strike it through a guard and the plate beneath.

name: Skysplitting Cry
description: Loose the school's highest cry in a single thread that parts a guard and the air behind it down to the ground.

name: Current Rap
description: Rap with a current of sound running down the arm so that the blow flows into the foe.

name: Constant Current
description: Keep a steady current of tone about the body that carries blows past it.

name: Whorl Step
description: Turn on the spot in a small eddy of sound and leave by the side the foe is not guarding.

name: Flow Reading
description: Read the direction in which a body moves by the way the current of sound bends round it.

name: Rolling Resonance
description: Roll the resonance of the body forward through a strike until it builds to a heavy shock.

name: Deep Current
description: Draw a deep slow current round one foe that drags at their limbs.

name: Healing Current
description: Pass a warm current of tone through an ally or the self that closes wounds and carries out the ache.

name: Backflow
description: Turn the current of an incoming strike back along its own path.

name: Flooding Chord
description: Flood a chord of surging tone across the field so that it sweeps up foes and throws them back.

name: Undertow Hum
description: Hum an undertow beneath the foe's feet that drags at their stance and strikes as they stumble.

name: Great Resonance
description: Gather the field into a single great resonance and release it as a wave that shatters stone and guards alike.

name: Resonant Deluge
description: Gather the resonance of the whole field like a swollen river and loose it in a deluge that bears everything before it.

name: Pledge Rap
description: Rap the foe with a knuckle that carries a spoken pledge.

name: Voiced Cover
description: Speak a low word that thickens the air about the user into a cover.

name: Hurried Pace
description: Hurry across the ground on the rise of a wind-borne cry.

name: Voice Pledge
description: Pledge the voice to the wind aloud so that breath and strength answer the pledge.

name: Windcall
description: Call to the wind and hear what it brings back of the field beyond sight.

name: Tethering Word
description: Speak a binding word that holds one foe to the place where they stand.

name: Oath Shout
description: Shout the oath at close range and strike on the final word.

name: Windborne Cry
description: Cry into the wind and let it carry the cry as a blow to a foe far across the open.

name: Oathcry
description: Cry out the oath at the highest pitch and strike with the full weight of every pledge behind it.

name: Oathcall
description: Call the oath of the academies aloud so that the wind answers with a wave of sound across the open ground.

name: Drum Rap
description: Rap on the foe as on a drumhead so that the beat travels deep.

name: Skin Guard
description: Stretch a drumskin of taut air across the front of the body to spring blows back.

name: Drumroll Step
description: Step in a quick drumroll of small paces that cannot be tracked.

name: Rolling Beat
description: Beat a rolling run of blows that keep the foe's guard dancing.

name: Marching Pulse
description: Beat a marching pulse that steadies the stride and breath of the user and nearby allies.

name: Drumhead Listening
description: Beat the ground like a drumhead and hear how the field answers about those upon it.

name: Broken Rhythm
description: Break the rhythm of the foe's movement with an off-beat strike that spoils their timing.

name: Thundering Drum
description: Beat a thundering drum that shakes the footing of every foe in the near field.

name: War Rhythm
description: Hold a war rhythm that drives the user and allies to strike together and to keep their guards in time.

name: Great Drumfall
description: Bring the drumsticks down in a great fall of beats that pound a wide ring of foes into the ground.

name: Ruin Cadence
description: Beat the school's closing cadence of ruin so that the whole rhythm lands in one crushing stroke upon the open ground.

name: Open Rap
description: Rap with an open hand and let the sound spread through the foe without a hidden edge.

name: Open Hum
description: Hum into the open field and let the hum hold back strikes from every side.

name: Heading Glide
description: Glide along a sounded bearing without drifting from it.

name: Maintained Heading
description: Hold a bearing on a moving foe by the sound of them and never lose them.

name: Straight Hum
description: Hum a note ruler-straight along the bearing and into the foe.

name: Fixing Tone
description: Hold a tone that pins the foe to the bearing so they cannot step aside from it.

name: Plumbline Strike
description: Strike down the line of the bearing with a note that does not scatter.

name: Steadfast Aegis
description: Hold an aegis of one unbroken tone that turns every sound and strike off its bearing.

name: Open Resonance
description: Open the whole field to one deep resonance and let it strike every foe on its bearing at once.

name: Bearing Resonance
description: Sound the school's resonance along a bearing taken on a foe so that it pierces them and pins them to that line.

name: Muted Rap
description: Rap with the sound drained from the blow so that only the force remains.

name: Muted Silence
description: Hollow out the sound round the user so that strikes lose their ring and their weight.

name: Silent Glide
description: Glide through the quiet like a shadow with no step to follow.

name: Silence Sensing
description: Read the shape of what lies in the silence by where the quiet is broken.

name: Dulling Pulse
description: Send a dulling pulse into the foe that muffles their senses and the feel of their weapon.

name: Hush Mending
description: Wrap an ally or the self in a deep calm where torn flesh and cracked bone knit unhurried.

name: Stilling Chord
description: Hold a stilling chord over one foe until they are slowed to a crawl.

name: Muting Strike
description: Strike a blow that mutes the foe's voice and their next technique along with their guard.

name: Wide Stillness
description: Spread a stillness over the field that dulls and slows every foe within.

name: Hushed Revival
description: Wrap an ally whose breath has just failed in a hush deep enough that the stopped pulse can start again before the window closes.

name: Unwalled Hush
description: Open a hush without walls that swallows the force of any blow or spell aimed at the user and allies.

name: Last Silence
description: Draw the last silence of the school across the field so that every foe in it is stilled and struck by the weight of the quiet.
